scene_meta.participants: Torhh, Korrhan, Saresh, Pazuzu, allied Igigi, Giant tribes (Tidecallers, Ash Giants, Desert, Forest, Mountain, Highland, Subterranean)
scene_meta.focus: Following seven days of preparation, the Giant tribes and allied Igigi initiate the Nephilim convergence; extreme heat, glacial cold, atmospheric pressure shifts, and gravitational flux simultaneously target the environmental vulnerabilities of the participating tribes while they struggle to maintain the shared consciousness network, causing old programmed suspicions to erupt under the strain.
scene_meta.continuity: 7 days after the Deep Communion in scene 012.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The commencement of the Nephilim ritual, the elemental convergence, and the first visible fracturing of the alliance under shared suffering.

scene_meta.location: Central Valley Ritual Grounds / distributed purification sites
scene_meta.time: year 10,550, month 1, day 11 at dusk, continuing over the following days
scene_meta.participants: five Nephilim (flame, water, earth, air, and aether aspects), Torhh, Korrhan, Saresh, Pazuzu, Giant tribes, allied Igigi, Gruulith, Dregans, Brajor
scene_meta.focus: Five Nephilim manifest at dusk and begin purifying Anunnaki-created life without distinguishing hostile creations from the allied Brajor; grief and blame intensify inside the already-fracturing collective, and Korrhan withdraws the Ash Giants from the consciousness network before the convergence can complete, ending the ritual conditions early and leaving the Giant tribes partially transformed, permanently damaged, and more deeply divided while the Nephilim continue their purification over the following days.
scene_meta.continuity: Begins at dusk on the same day as scene 014.1; the Nephilim complete their purification over the following days, eliminating the Gruulith, Dregans, and Brajor and leaving the Giant alliance shattered before the aftermath depicted in chapter 015.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Nephilim manifestation, destruction of the allied Brajor alongside hostile Anunnaki creations, Korrhan's premature break from the convergence, and the permanent fracture and partial transformation of the Giant alliance.
